next_unlock_sentence: As of Nov 20, 2026, no upcoming ETHFI unlocks are scheduled. ETHFI is released continuously: about 1.02m ETHFI per week ($482,294 per week at the Nov 20, 2026 price, 5.31% of circulating supply a year), for Core Contributors.
token_buyback_details: Portion of protocol revenue is used to buy back ETHFI, another portion goes to the Foundation treasury.
token_economic_rights: 40% of revenue goes to Labs to cover expenses, 30% buys ETHFI on open market & is held in Foundation treasury, and 30% buys ETHFI on open market delivered to users as cashback rewards.
quality_status: baseline; key metrics cross-referenced across DefiLlama, CoinGecko and official Ether.fi materials
